text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I... am victorious! Surely everyone in 
attendance thought it: that this was a 
legendary race etched forever into Derby 
history!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I even secured a worthy rival capable of 
delivering a battle hotter than the 
"Golden Generation"! ...Yet she declined! 
She must be shy about the honor of running 
alongside a king.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
However, the winds of the era are blowing 
in my favor! Even without a worthy rival, 
the crowd is in a frenzy... waiting for 
the bell marking the change of generations 
to chime!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Then let us go ring that bell. Toward the 
Arima Kinen—where the "Golden Generation" 
awaits!
